Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ResponseFormat, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "Respond with JSON only.", role: "system" }, { content: "Give me a user object with name and age fields.", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", responseFormat: { type: "json_object" } as ResponseFormat });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
```
